dataset: ABA law school application, offer and enrollment trends, 2015-2025
source: American Bar Association 1L JD Applicant / First-Year Class Data
license: Free to use with attribution. The underlying data is published by the American Bar Association.
notes: Year is the entering class year, not the year the report was published.
A missing school-year combination means the school did not report that year. It is absent from this file entirely, never zero.
applications / matriculants are always present. offers is blank for two schools in 2025 because the ABA blank field was read upstream as 0; see the site's data guide.
The 2017 ABA questionnaire changed the definition of the first-year class (leaves of absence, admits with fewer than fifteen credits), so 2017 is not perfectly comparable with 2016 and earlier.
